summary:
Implementation plan to eliminate GoDaddy 'Under Maintenance' errors and resolve direct URL reloads across all 136 routes:
1. Fix Phusion Passenger Node.js entry point crash by supporting both CommonJS require() and ES Module import() and proper Unix socket / TCP port listening.
2. Build an automated Static Route Generator that creates physical index.html files inside dedicated directories for every single route in dist/ (e.g. dist/service/amer-residency-visa-new/index.html).
3. Enhance cPanel static fallback and server routing so every page opens immediately on direct paste or reload.
